name: edit-pptx-decks
description: Edit and audit PowerPoint .pptx decks programmatically: a headless render-and-verify loop (LibreOffice → PDF → PNG) with automatic font substitution, plus fixes for the failure modes that only surface once PowerPoint opens the file — stripped slide-number fallbacks, blipFill without a stretch, aspect-ratio distortion, wrap="none" overflow, and TIFF portability. Also covers inserting native OMML equations, which python-pptx cannot do.
